tests.title: PrepareArguments preserves original tool input bytes verbatim when no mutation occurs
given: a tool with a defined InputSchema and a ToolUseBlock with input JSON bytes
tests.when: PrepareArguments is invoked on valid arguments without tool mutation or repairs
then: PreparedArguments.Raw is identical byte-for-byte to the original ToolUseBlock.Input bytes
PreparedArguments.Args contains the unmarshaled argument values
tests.pseudocode: inputBytes := json.RawMessage(`{"query":"test","limit":10}`); block := core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "t1", Name: "search", Input: inputBytes}; prep, err := core.PrepareArguments(tool, block); assert err == nil; assert bytes.Equal(prep.Raw, inputBytes); assert prep.Args["query"] == "test"

tests.title: PrepareArguments re-encodes raw JSON when tool argument preparer mutates inputs
given: a tool with a non-nil PrepareArguments hook that adds default parameter values
tests.when: core.PrepareArguments processes the tool use block and applies the mutation hook
then: PreparedArguments.Raw is updated with the re-encoded JSON bytes reflecting the mutation
PreparedArguments.Args reflects the mutated argument map
tests.pseudocode: tool.PrepareArguments = func(args map[string]any) (map[string]any, error) { args["injected"] = true; return args, nil }; block := core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "t1", Name: "custom", Input: json.RawMessage(`{"v":1}`)}; prep, err := core.PrepareArguments(tool, block); assert err == nil; assert strings.Contains(string(prep.Raw), `"injected":true`); assert prep.Args["injected"] == true

tests.title: PrepareArguments rejects arguments violating tool input schema with validation error
given: a tool with an InputSchema requiring an integer property "count"
tests.when: PrepareArguments is invoked with JSON arguments failing schema validation
then: returns zero-value PreparedArguments and non-nil error wrapping the schema validation issue
tests.pseudocode: tool := core.Tool{InputSchema: schema.Object(schema.Prop("count", schema.Int()))}; block := core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "t1", Name: "t", Input: json.RawMessage(`{"count":"invalid_string"}`)}; prep, err := core.PrepareArguments(tool, block); assert err != nil; assert len(prep.Raw) == 0; assert prep.Args == nil

tests.title: schema.Parse preserves authored property declaration order in PropertyOrder using jsontext
given: a JSON Schema string with properties authored in non-alphabetical order 'zebra', 'apple', 'mango'
tests.when: schema.Parse decodes the schema bytes using jsontext
then: schema.Parse returns a non-nil *Schema with PropertyOrder exactly equal to ['zebra', 'apple', 'mango']
tests.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"type":"object","properties":{"zebra":{"type":"string"},"apple":{"type":"string"},"mango":{"type":"string"}}}`); s, err := schema.Parse(raw); assert err == nil; assert s.PropertyOrder == []string{"zebra", "apple", "mango"}

tests.title: schema.Parse decodes all standard JSON Schema keywords into typed fields
given: a JSON Schema string declaring full standard schema keywords
tests.when: schema.Parse decodes the schema bytes
then: Properties map contains child schemas for each property
Required, Type, Description, Title, Items, Enum, Const, Nullable, AnyOf, OneOf, and AllOf match declared JSON keywords
tests.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"type":"string","description":"test","title":"Test","enum":["a","b"],"const":"a","nullable":true}`); s, err := schema.Parse(raw); assert err == nil; assert s.Type == schema.TypeString; assert s.Description == "test"; assert s.Title == "Test"; assert len(s.Enum) == 2; assert s.HasConst == true; assert s.Nullable == true

tests.title: schema.Parse preserves unmodeled keywords in Schema.Extra in declaration order
given: a JSON Schema string containing unmodeled keywords '$comment', 'x-custom', 'deprecated' in order
tests.when: schema.Parse decodes the schema bytes
then: Schema.Extra contains all unmodeled keywords with values matching source JSON
the declaration order of unmodeled keywords in Schema.Extra is preserved
tests.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"type":"object","$comment":"note","x-custom":"val","deprecated":true}`); s, err := schema.Parse(raw); assert err == nil; assert s.Extra["$comment"] == "note"; assert s.Extra["x-custom"] == "val"; assert s.Extra["deprecated"] == true

tests.title: schema.Parse rejects malformed or truncated JSON bytes with error
given: a malformed JSON Schema byte slice with an unclosed object token
tests.when: schema.Parse is invoked with syntactically malformed JSON bytes or unclosed tokens
then: returns nil *Schema and non-nil error
tests.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"type":"object","properties":{`); s, err := schema.Parse(raw); assert s == nil; assert err != nil

tests.title: schema.Validate rejects undeclared properties when AdditionalProperties Allowed is false
given: a Schema configured with AdditionalProperties Allowed set to false and declared property 'name'
tests.when: Validate is called on an object containing properties not listed in Properties or PropertyOrder when AdditionalProperties has Allowed set to false
then: returns non-nil error mentioning property not allowed
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Object(schema.Prop("name", schema.String())).Closed(); err := schema.Validate(s, map[string]any{"name": "test", "extra": 123}); assert err != nil; assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not allowed")

tests.title: schema.Validate rejects values not matching declared Enum literals
given: a Schema with Enum values ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT']
tests.when: Validate is called on a value that does not match any declared Enum literal in value and type
then: returns non-nil error indicating value must be one of declared enum choices
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Object(schema.Prop("method", schema.Enum("m", "GET", "POST", "PUT"))); err := schema.Validate(s, map[string]any{"method": "get"}); assert err != nil; assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "one of")

tests.title: schema.Validate rejects numeric values violating bounds or multipleOf constraints
given: a Schema specifying Minimum 10, Maximum 50, and MultipleOf 5
tests.when: Validate is called on a numeric value violating declared Minimum, Maximum, ExclusiveMinimum, ExclusiveMaximum, or MultipleOf constraints
then: returns non-nil error indicating relational constraint violation
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Object(schema.Prop("num", schema.Int().Min(10).Max(50))); errLow := schema.Validate(s, map[string]any{"num": 5}); assert errLow != nil; assert strings.Contains(errLow.Error(), "at least"); errHigh := schema.Validate(s, map[string]any{"num": 60}); assert errHigh != nil; assert strings.Contains(errHigh.Error(), "at most")

tests.title: schema.Validate rejects strings violating MinLength, MaxLength, or Pattern
given: a Schema specifying MinLength 5, MaxLength 10, and Pattern '^[a-z]+$'
tests.when: Validate is called on a string violating MinLength, MaxLength, or failing to match Pattern
then: returns non-nil error indicating length or regex pattern mismatch
tests.pseudocode: s := &schema.Schema{Type: schema.TypeString, MinLength: ptr(5), MaxLength: ptr(10), Pattern: "^[a-z]+$"}; errShort := schema.Validate(s, "abc"); assert errShort != nil; errPattern := schema.Validate(s, "abc123"); assert errPattern != nil

tests.title: schema.Validate rejects arrays violating MinItems, MaxItems, or UniqueItems
given: a Schema specifying MinItems 2, MaxItems 4, and UniqueItems true
tests.when: Validate is called on an array violating MinItems, MaxItems, or containing duplicate items when UniqueItems is true
then: returns non-nil error indicating cardinality or uniqueness violation
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Array(schema.Int()); s.MinItems = ptr(2); s.MaxItems = ptr(4); s.UniqueItems = ptr(true); errDup := schema.Validate(s, []any{1, 1}); assert errDup != nil; errShort := schema.Validate(s, []any{1}); assert errShort != nil

tests.title: schema.Coerce converts valid string numbers and booleans and records Coercions
given: a Schema with integer, number, and boolean properties
tests.when: Coerce parses string representations of valid numbers or booleans matching the target schema
then: the converted map contains numeric 42.5 and boolean true
the returned coercions list contains entries for each converted field
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Object(schema.Prop("n", schema.Number()), schema.Prop("b", schema.Boolean())); out, coercions := schema.Coerce(s, map[string]any{"n": "42.5", "b": "true"}); assert out["n"] == 42.5; assert out["b"] == true; assert len(coercions) == 2

tests.title: schema.Coerce refuses non-standard numeric string representations
given: a Schema expecting an integer property 'count'
tests.when: Coerce encounters non-standard string representations such as NaN, Inf, +5, .5, 5., or 1_0 targeting a number or integer schema
then: returns unchanged value without emitting non-standard numeric literals
tests.pseudocode: s := schema.Object(schema.Prop("count", schema.Int())); for _, bad := range []string{"NaN", "Inf", "+5", ".5", "5.", "1_0"} { out, coercions := schema.Coerce(s, map[string]any{"count": bad}); assert out["count"] == bad; assert len(coercions) == 0 }

tests.title: guard.Restricted BeforeToolCall hook enforces tool blocks, shell operators, and env assignments before Check
given: guard.Options with BlockedTools ['danger_tool'], AllowShellOperators false, AllowEnvPrefixes false, and AllowedPrograms ['git']
tests.when: Restricted creates a BeforeToolCall hook and receives a tool invocation
then: call to secret_tool is blocked with refusal reason
call to execute with pipe operator is blocked
call to execute with dangerous env assignment prefix is blocked
call to execute with allowed program succeeds without block
tests.pseudocode: opts := guard.Options{BlockedTools: []string{"danger_tool"}, AllowShellOperators: false, AllowEnvPrefixes: false, AllowedPrograms: []string{"git"}}; hook := guard.Restricted(opts); decBlocked := hook(ctx, core.BeforeToolCallContext{ToolName: "danger_tool"}); assert decBlocked.Block == true; decPipe := hook(ctx, core.BeforeToolCallContext{ToolName: "execute", Arguments: map[string]any{"command": "git status | cat"}}); assert decPipe.Block == true; decEnv := hook(ctx, core.BeforeToolCallContext{ToolName: "execute", Arguments: map[string]any{"command": "PATH=/tmp git status"}}); assert decEnv.Block == true; decOk := hook(ctx, core.BeforeToolCallContext{ToolName: "execute", Arguments: map[string]any{"command": "git commit"}}); assert decOk.Block == false

tests.title: Prompt builder assembles instructions and provider client streams events
given: tools list with file navigation and execute tools, and a ProviderClient implementation
tests.when: prompt.Build generates system prompt text, core.Request is constructed, and ProviderClient.Stream is invoked
then: assembled prompt contains base instructions and deduplicated guidelines in first-seen order
ProviderClient.Stream accepts Request and returns a channel streaming StreamEvent values to completion
tests.pseudocode: toolsList := []core.Tool{{Name: "read_file", PromptGuidelines: []string{"Read before editing."}}, {Name: "execute"}}; sysPrompt := prompt.Build("", toolsList); assert strings.Contains(sysPrompt, "Read before editing."); req := core.Request{System: []core.ContentBlock{core.TextBlock{Text: sysPrompt}}}; ch, err := providerClient.Stream(context.Background(), req); assert err == nil; ev := <-ch; assert ev.Err == nil
